name: comp-412
title: Social Proof Avatars
description: A slim outlined pill holding four overlapping miniature portraits and the line Trusted by 60K+ developers, with the figure set in bright white.
use: A compact strip of social proof directly below a hero or beside a signup button.
avoid: When the number must be truthful: the 60K+ figure and portrait files are fixed in the source.
a11y: Each portrait has alt text and the claim is real selectable text, so it reads cleanly; nothing here is interactive. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A low rounded capsule with a hairline border and soft shadow rests on black. Inside, four 20px circular faces overlap tightly at the left, then a dim grey sentence follows with 60K+ picked out in bold near-white.
behaves: Static: the capsule, faces and wording never move or respond. Only the recording cursor drifts past underneath.
customise: The sentence, its bold figure and the four portrait files are written inside; changing any means editing the file. The capsule's border, padding and shadow are classes.
weight: light: Four tiny images, a line of text and a border; nothing runs or loops.
